default_cache_control.description: The default Cache-Control header value to apply to all deployed files. If not specified, no Cache-Control header will be set.

source.description: The S3 bucket and path to the ZIP file containing the source files to be deployed. Format: 'bucket-name/path/to/source.zip'.

source_version.description: The version ID of the source ZIP file in the S3 bucket. This is used to handle versioning of files in S3. If not specified, the latest version will be used.

target.description: The target S3 bucket where the unzipped files will be deployed.

target_region.description: The target region of the S3 bucket where the unzipped files will be deployed.

cache_control.description: The Cache-Control header value to apply to this specific file.

file.description: The exact path of the file within the ZIP archive to override.

block.description: Override the Cache-Control header for specific files. Each file path must be unique across all overrides.
Deploys a set of files from a source ZIP file in an S3 bucket to a target S3 bucket.
